description: GTEx Portal gene expression (public API v2, no key): median TPM of one gene in human tissues, sorted highest first, with the GENCODE id it was matched to. Uses GTEx v8 data; unknown gene symbols return 404. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
